fusions.name: Worrying Bite
fusions.desc: Clamps onto the target and wraps it in your arms, dealing 14 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Flushed for the Pack
fusions.desc: Rakes every arm through a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 26 damage to everything in it. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Steadying Arm
fusions.desc: Wraps an arm around the ally who needs it most and restores 3 health a second to them for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Inkhound
fusions.desc: A bonded hound with suckered legs runs with you, biting enemies within 4.5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. It holds on to what it bites: the target moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.
